notes.title: V. 1.0.2 - Minor bugfix
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Version 1.0.2

Bug Fixes:

Hopefully resolved issue where the forklift would become stuck in full-speed forward motion.
Fixed minor bugs improving overall stability and performance.

New Feature:

Added a new setting that allows users to select between keyboard and joypad controls for enhanced customization.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any further issues or have suggestions for improvement, please don't hesitate to reach out.
